item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 02/Feb/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will affect the coast of Guangdong today. Temperatures in the morning will remain relatively low over the region, and the weather will be mainly fine. With the monsoon being replaced by an easterly airstream, temperatures will rise progressively over the coast of southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week. The weather will become humid. The northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China during the weekend. It will become cool over the region in the following couple of days.
